messages:
maria: Quick report from the bootcamp today — two folks hit 401s following the "Getting Started" README. Both copy/pasted env var names and curl examples.

kevin: Ugh. Which snippets were wrong?

maria: The CLI example shows `--token` and the quickstart curl uses `-H 'Authorization: $REDWOOD_KEY'`. Our runtime expects REDWOOD_API_KEY and Bearer.

lee: That's been a recurring drift. Samples/containers still set `AUTH_TOKEN` in Dockerfiles too. New hires paste whatever they see and are blocked.

indra: Can you paste the exact failing lines? I'll draft a quick patch.

maria: Sure — current README has:
```bash
# README (wrong)
redwood --token $TOKEN generate --model=redwood-v1 --prompt "hello"

curl -H 'Authorization: $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","prompt":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maria: Corrected ones I'd propose:
```bash
# Bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk_live_..."
redwood generate --model=redwood-v1 --prompt "hello"

# curl (explicit Bearer + Accept)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","prompt":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# PowerShell (session-only env)
$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = 'sk_live_...'
redwood generate --model redwood-v1 --prompt "hello"
```

kevin: Nice. Also, Node sample currently does `new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })` while Python shows implicit env lookup. We should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY and show both methods (env + explicit constructor) per SDK.

lee: Agreed. Also worth documenting that the CLI supports `--api-key` as a one-off flag (we prefer env for scripts) so folks know both options.

indra: Small but painful: our retry docs are vague. People ask why SDKs behave differently. Quick list?

maria: From current runtime/SDKs: CLI default retries = 3, Node SDK default retries = 5, Python SDK default retries = 3. We should list those defaults and link to the retry config.

jen: I'll add a 1-line table under "Troubleshooting: auth & retries" and include how to override in each SDK. Example snippet for Node: `new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, retries: { maxAttempts: 2 } })`.

kevin: Also please add a short security note: never bake tokens into images. Found a Dockerfile in samples with `ENV AUTH_TOKEN=sk_test_...`. Replace with build-time args + docs example using runtime env.

lee: Can we add a tiny CI linter in samples repo that fails if README env var names don't match env vars in sample files? That would prevent drift.

indra: Good call. I'll open a follow-up issue for a lint check.

docs-bot: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/721 - "sync quickstart: REDWOOD_API_KEY parity, curl Bearer, retry defaults, PS examples" assigned to @jen

maria: PR incoming in ~40m — will fix README, two SDK snippets (Node + Python), Dockerfile, and add the troubleshooting note. tagging @kevin and @lee for SDK checks.

kevin: I'll review Node, confirm the exact retry semantics and update example for overriding backoff/jitter.

lee: I'll review Python and the Dockerfile changes. If we add linting we can lower future churn.

maria: thanks all. small edits but big win for first-run experience. :tada:
